interest_type.description: Kind of interest in land being sold, bought or transferred. 'other' covers e.g. leases of 30 years or less, easements, mortgagee interests, standalone licences to occupy.

directly_advances_transaction.description: Caller's view: the business acts on instructions and takes active steps that directly advance the transaction (not only general advice or ancillary services).

transaction_exists.description: A buyer and seller have agreed a price (private treaty), or a buyer was successful at auction that met reserve.

court_or_tribunal_order.description: The transfer is pursuant to, or results from, a court or tribunal order.

transaction_value_aud.description: Informational only. No rule uses it yet (see RULES_TO_VERIFY.md).

foreign_person.description: Informational. No active rule uses it (see RULES_TO_VERIFY.md).

pep_status.description: As determined by the caller for the customer, beneficial owners and persons acting for or on behalf of the customer.

sanctions_status.description: Designation for targeted financial sanctions, as determined by the caller.

high_risk_jurisdiction_link.description: Customer, a beneficial owner, or a person acting for or on behalf of the customer is physically present in or formed in a jurisdiction the FATF has called on members to apply enhanced due diligence to.

ml_tf_risk_rating.description: The business's own ML/TF risk rating for the customer.

unusual_transaction.description: Unusually complex or large, no apparent economic or legal purpose, or an unusual pattern of transactions.

suspicion_formed.description: A person in the business reports that a suspicion relevant to a suspicious matter report has formed.
